name: World ID Next.js verification example
description: Next.js integration reference connecting IDKitWidget.handleVerify to a server API route that calls verifyCloudProof and drives a success display.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
metadata.overlap: World ID client integration, not the biometric recognition system or a standalone authentication server. Session confirmation/client UI success does not establish application authorization; verify proofs and bind actions/signals on a trusted backend.
metadata.deployment_warning: Demo accepts application/action/signal from request data and query parameters. Production authorization must fix expected values server-side and enforce replay/nullifier policy.
